findings.message: settled-WOT lambda runs lean by +0.068 (above the +0.05 High line)
findings.title: Lambda

findings.message: PUT overshoots setpoint by +10.6 kPa near 3048 rpm (below the +20 kPa High line); primary zone — transient spike at 3048-3048 rpm: mean +10.6 / peak +10.6 kPa over 0.04 s (pull 8)
findings.title: Boost tracking

findings.message: PUT runs 6.8 kPa under setpoint on average (peak -10.0 kPa) for 3.12 s from 4559-6009 rpm (pull 4); the wastegate integral winds from -0.1% to 12.9% across the zone while the final command sits 18.2 points above the position feedforward (`wg_pos_base`) — the closed loop is carrying a shortfall the position feedforward is leaving, so the feedforward is commanding too little there
findings.title: Boost shortfall

findings.message: minor knock retard to -2.2 deg (below the -3.0 deg High line)
findings.title: Knock retard

findings.message: fuel headroom watch: worst DI rail sag -7.3 bar; LPFP duty peaks 79.3%; HPFP eff. volume peaks 97.3%
findings.title: Rail pressure and pump headroom

findings.message: heat/turbo watch: turbo speed peaks 204 krpm; IAT peaks 33 C; coolant peaks 100 C; oil peaks 111 C
findings.title: Turbo and heat

findings.message: demanded manifold-pressure setpoint peak (map_sp) 310.9 kPa stays under the `C_PRS_IM_SP_MAX` ceiling 35000.0 kPa (margin 34689.1 kPa)
findings.title: Boost vs calibrated ceiling

findings.message: logged PUT-minus-ambient peaks 1899 hPa, under the `IP_PUT_AMP_DIF_MAX_PRS_DIF_THR` P0234 threshold 2700 hPa (margin 801 hPa)
findings.title: P0234 overboost margin
